name: Đồ ăn và nấu ăn
description: Thực phẩm, gia vị, món ăn, dụng cụ bếp và cách nấu: những từ thường gặp chưa có trong bộ 3000 từ. Nội dung do AI soạn. Giấy phép CC BY-SA 4.0.

words.explanationEn: one of the foods you mix together to make a dish
words.example: Rice is the main ingredient of this dish.
words.exampleVi: Gạo là nguyên liệu chính của món này.

words.explanationEn: meat from a cow
words.example: I'd like a bowl of beef noodle soup.
words.exampleVi: Cho tôi một bát phở bò.

words.explanationEn: a black or white powder with a hot taste, added to food
words.example: Add a little salt and pepper.
words.exampleVi: Thêm một chút muối và tiêu.

words.explanationEn: a white powder made from wheat, used to make bread and cakes
words.example: Mix the flour with two eggs.
words.exampleVi: Trộn bột mì với hai quả trứng.

words.explanationEn: a thick liquid served with food to give it more taste
words.example: The chicken comes with a sweet sauce.
words.exampleVi: Món gà được ăn kèm nước sốt ngọt.

words.explanationEn: a hot-tasting root used in cooking and in tea
words.example: Ginger tea is good when you have a cold.
words.exampleVi: Trà gừng rất tốt khi bạn bị cảm.

words.explanationEn: a small red or green pod that makes food very hot
words.example: Don't put too much chili in my soup.
words.exampleVi: Đừng cho quá nhiều ớt vào canh của tôi.

words.explanationEn: a plant without leaves, often shaped like an umbrella, that you can eat
words.example: She fried the mushrooms with garlic.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy xào nấm với tỏi.

words.explanationEn: a large round vegetable with thick green or purple leaves
words.example: We had boiled cabbage with fish sauce.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi ăn bắp cải luộc chấm nước mắm.

words.explanationEn: a green leafy vegetable eaten raw in salads
words.example: Wash the lettuce before you eat it.
words.exampleVi: Rửa xà lách trước khi ăn.

words.explanationEn: a long green vegetable with a lot of juice inside, often eaten raw
words.example: Slice the cucumber thinly.
words.exampleVi: Thái mỏng dưa chuột.

words.explanationEn: a seed that grows in a long pod and is cooked as food
words.example: This soup is made with red beans.
words.exampleVi: Món súp này nấu bằng đậu đỏ.

words.explanationEn: a small nut that grows under the ground
words.example: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy bị dị ứng đậu phộng.

words.explanationEn: a large tropical fruit with rough brown skin and sweet yellow flesh
words.example: Cut the pineapple into small pieces.
words.exampleVi: Cắt dứa thành miếng nhỏ.

words.explanationEn: a very large round fruit with green skin, red flesh and black seeds
words.example: Watermelon is perfect on a hot day.
words.exampleVi: Dưa hấu rất hợp cho ngày nóng.

words.explanationEn: a large hard brown fruit with white flesh and sweet milky juice
words.example: I drank fresh coconut juice at the beach.
words.exampleVi: Tôi uống nước dừa tươi ở bãi biển.

words.explanationEn: a small green fruit that tastes like a lemon
words.example: Squeeze some lime over the noodles.
words.exampleVi: Vắt một ít chanh lên mì.

words.explanationEn: a soft round fruit with fuzzy skin and a large stone inside
words.example: These peaches are very sweet.
words.exampleVi: Những quả đào này rất ngọt.

words.explanationEn: a sweet juicy fruit that is narrow at the top and wide at the bottom
words.example: She put a pear in her lunch box.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy cho một quả lê vào hộp cơm trưa.

words.explanationEn: a small round red fruit with a stone inside
words.example: There is a cherry on top of the cake.
words.exampleVi: Có một quả anh đào trên mặt bánh.

words.explanationEn: a green fruit with a large seed and soft creamy flesh
words.example: Avocado smoothies are popular in Vietnam.
words.exampleVi: Sinh tố bơ rất được ưa chuộng ở Việt Nam.

words.explanationEn: a vegetable with dark green leaves
words.meaningVi: rau chân vịt, cải bó xôi
words.example: Spinach is full of iron.
words.exampleVi: Rau chân vịt có nhiều chất sắt.

words.explanationEn: a green vegetable with a thick stem and many small flower heads
words.example: The kids don't like broccoli.
words.exampleVi: Bọn trẻ không thích súp lơ xanh.

words.explanationEn: a vegetable with shiny purple skin and soft white flesh
words.example: Grilled eggplant with green onion is delicious.
words.exampleVi: Cà tím nướng mỡ hành rất ngon.

words.explanationEn: a large round orange vegetable with hard skin
words.example: Mom made pumpkin soup for dinner.
words.exampleVi: Mẹ nấu canh bí đỏ cho bữa tối.

words.explanationEn: a soft white food made from soya beans
words.example: Fried tofu with tomato sauce is easy to make.
words.exampleVi: Đậu phụ sốt cà chua rất dễ làm.

words.explanationEn: salty meat from a pig, often fried in thin pieces
words.example: He had bacon and eggs for breakfast.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy ăn sáng với thịt xông khói và trứng.

words.explanationEn: meat from the leg of a pig that has been salted or smoked
words.example: I'll have a ham sandwich, please.
words.exampleVi: Cho tôi một bánh mì kẹp giăm bông.

words.explanationEn: meat from a young sheep
words.example: Have you ever tried roast lamb?
words.exampleVi: Bạn đã bao giờ ăn thịt cừu nướng chưa?

words.explanationEn: a large pink fish that lives in the sea and swims up rivers
words.example: Salmon is expensive here.
words.exampleVi: Cá hồi ở đây đắt.

words.explanationEn: a large sea fish, often sold in cans
words.example: She opened a can of tuna.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy mở một hộp cá ngừ.

words.explanationEn: a sea animal with a hard shell, ten legs and two large claws
words.example: We ate crab soup with noodles.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi ăn bún riêu cua.

words.explanationEn: a sea animal with a long soft body and ten arms
words.example: Grilled squid is a popular street food.
words.exampleVi: Mực nướng là món ăn đường phố được ưa chuộng.

words.explanationEn: a sweet food made by boiling fruit with sugar, spread on bread
words.example: I like strawberry jam on toast.
words.exampleVi: Tôi thích phết mứt dâu lên bánh mì nướng.

words.explanationEn: a sour liquid made from wine or rice, used to flavor food
words.example: Add a spoon of vinegar to the salad.
words.exampleVi: Cho một thìa giấm vào món nộm.

words.explanationEn: a dark salty liquid made from a kind of bean, used in Asian cooking
words.example: Dip the dumplings in soy sauce.
words.exampleVi: Chấm há cảo vào xì dầu.

words.explanationEn: a salty brown liquid made from salted anchovies, common in Vietnamese cooking
words.example: Mix fish sauce with lime, sugar and garlic.
words.exampleVi: Pha nước mắm với chanh, đường và tỏi.

words.explanationEn: a yellow-green liquid fat pressed from small fruits, used for cooking and salads
words.example: Fry the onions in olive oil.
words.exampleVi: Phi hành bằng dầu ô liu.

words.explanationEn: a yellow, hot-tasting paste eaten with meat
words.example: Do you want mustard on your hot dog?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có muốn cho mù tạt vào bánh mì xúc xích không?

words.explanationEn: a thick red sauce made from tomatoes
words.example: The children put ketchup on their fries.
words.exampleVi: Bọn trẻ chấm khoai tây chiên với tương cà.

words.explanationEn: a plant whose leaves are used to add taste to food
words.example: Vietnamese food uses a lot of fresh herbs.
words.exampleVi: Món Việt dùng rất nhiều rau thơm tươi.

words.explanationEn: a plant with fresh-smelling leaves, used in drinks and food
words.example: Put some mint in the spring rolls.
words.exampleVi: Cho ít bạc hà vào gỏi cuốn.

words.explanationEn: small flat seeds used in cooking and to make oil
words.example: Sprinkle sesame seeds on top.
words.exampleVi: Rắc vừng lên trên.

words.explanationEn: a tall tropical plant with a fresh sour smell, used in Asian cooking
words.example: Chicken with lemongrass and chili is my favorite.
words.exampleVi: Gà xào sả ớt là món tôi thích nhất.

words.explanationEn: a sweet brown spice made from the bark of a tree
words.example: This cake smells of cinnamon.
words.exampleVi: Chiếc bánh này có mùi quế.

words.explanationEn: a mix of flour and water that is baked to make bread
words.example: Leave the dough to rest for an hour.
words.exampleVi: Để bột nghỉ trong một giờ.

words.explanationEn: a substance added to bread so that it grows bigger before baking
words.example: You need yeast to make this bread.
words.exampleVi: Bạn cần men nở để làm loại bánh mì này.

words.explanationEn: a thin flat round food made from flour, eggs and milk, cooked in a pan
words.example: We had pancakes with honey.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi ăn bánh kếp với mật ong.

words.explanationEn: eggs beaten together and fried in a pan, often with other food inside
words.example: He made a cheese omelet.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy làm món trứng tráng phô mai.

words.explanationEn: a small ball of dough filled with meat or vegetables, then boiled or steamed
words.example: These dumplings are filled with pork.
words.exampleVi: Những chiếc há cảo này nhân thịt lợn.

words.explanationEn: rice paper wrapped around vegetables and meat, then fried or eaten fresh
words.example: My aunt makes the best spring rolls.
words.exampleVi: Cô tôi làm nem ngon nhất.

words.explanationEn: a soft hot food made by cooking rice or oats in water or milk
words.example: When I was sick, my mother cooked rice porridge.
words.exampleVi: Khi tôi ốm, mẹ nấu cháo.

words.explanationEn: a dish of meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid
words.example: Beef stew is perfect for cold days.
words.exampleVi: Bò hầm rất hợp cho ngày lạnh.

words.explanationEn: food that is still there after a meal is finished
words.example: We had the leftovers for lunch.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi ăn đồ thừa cho bữa trưa.

words.explanationEn: a drink of any kind
words.example: Hot beverages are served in the lobby.
words.exampleVi: Đồ uống nóng được phục vụ ở sảnh.

words.explanationEn: a piece of kitchen equipment with burners for cooking food
words.example: Turn off the stove when you leave.
words.exampleVi: Tắt bếp khi bạn ra ngoài.

words.explanationEn: a deep round metal pot with a long handle
words.example: Heat the milk in a small saucepan.
words.exampleVi: Đun sữa trong một chiếc nồi nhỏ.

words.explanationEn: a flat round metal dish with a long handle, for cooking food in hot fat
words.example: Heat some oil in a frying pan.
words.exampleVi: Đun nóng ít dầu trong chảo.

words.explanationEn: a large round-bottomed pan used in Chinese cooking
words.example: He cooked the noodles in a wok.
words.exampleVi: Anh ấy xào mì trong chảo sâu lòng.

words.explanationEn: a metal or plastic pot with a spout, for boiling water
words.example: Put the kettle on, let's have tea.
words.exampleVi: Đun ấm nước đi, mình uống trà.

words.explanationEn: the cover on top of a pot or box
words.example: Put the lid on the pot.
words.exampleVi: Đậy nắp nồi lại.

words.explanationEn: a large deep spoon with a long handle for serving soup
words.example: Use a ladle to serve the soup.
words.exampleVi: Dùng muôi để múc canh.

words.explanationEn: a kitchen tool with a wide flat blade for turning or lifting food
words.example: Turn the fish over with a spatula.
words.exampleVi: Lật cá bằng xẻng lật.

words.explanationEn: two thin pieces of wood or plastic held in one hand to eat with
words.example: Can you eat with chopsticks?
words.exampleVi: Bạn có biết ăn bằng đũa không?

words.explanationEn: a thick flat piece of wood or plastic for chopping food on
words.example: Use a different cutting board for raw meat.
words.exampleVi: Dùng thớt riêng cho thịt sống.

words.explanationEn: a small piece of cutlery for stirring tea, or the amount it holds
words.example: Add one teaspoon of sugar.
words.exampleVi: Thêm một thìa cà phê đường.

words.explanationEn: a large piece of cutlery for serving food, or the amount it holds
words.example: Add two tablespoons of fish sauce.
words.exampleVi: Thêm hai thìa canh nước mắm.

words.explanationEn: an electric machine that mixes or crushes food into a liquid
words.example: Put the fruit and ice in the blender.
words.exampleVi: Cho trái cây và đá vào máy xay.

words.explanationEn: an electric machine that makes slices of bread brown and crisp
words.example: The toaster is next to the fridge.
words.exampleVi: Máy nướng bánh mì ở cạnh tủ lạnh.

words.explanationEn: a flat board with raised edges for carrying plates and cups
words.example: She carried the drinks on a tray.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy bưng đồ uống trên khay.

words.explanationEn: a piece of cloth you wear over your clothes to keep them clean while cooking
words.example: Put on an apron before you start.
words.exampleVi: Đeo tạp dề trước khi bắt đầu.

words.explanationEn: a printed collection of recipes
words.example: I found this recipe in an old cookbook.
words.exampleVi: Tôi tìm thấy công thức này trong một cuốn sách nấu ăn cũ.

words.explanationEn: to heat a liquid until bubbles rise in it, or to cook food in such a liquid
words.example: Boil the eggs for eight minutes.
words.exampleVi: Luộc trứng trong tám phút.

words.explanationEn: to cook food in hot oil
words.example: She fried the fish until it was golden.
words.exampleVi: Cô ấy rán cá đến khi vàng.

words.explanationEn: to cut something into pieces with a knife
words.example: Chop the onions finely.
words.exampleVi: Băm nhỏ hành.

words.explanationEn: to take the skin off a fruit or vegetable
words.example: Peel the potatoes and cut them in half.
words.exampleVi: Gọt vỏ khoai tây và cắt đôi.

words.explanationEn: to cook food on metal bars over strong heat
words.example: We grilled pork over charcoal.
words.exampleVi: Chúng tôi nướng thịt lợn trên than.

words.explanationEn: to cook meat or vegetables in an oven or over a fire
words.example: Roast the chicken for an hour.
words.exampleVi: Nướng gà trong một giờ.

words.explanationEn: to cook food over boiling water, in the hot gas it gives off
words.example: Steam the fish with ginger.
words.exampleVi: Hấp cá với gừng.

words.explanationEn: to cook something gently, just below boiling
words.example: Let the soup simmer for twenty minutes.
words.exampleVi: Để canh sôi lăn tăn trong hai mươi phút.

words.explanationEn: to cook small pieces of food quickly in hot oil while mixing them
words.example: Stir-fry the vegetables for two minutes.
words.exampleVi: Xào rau trong hai phút.

words.explanationEn: to leave meat or fish in a mix of oil and spices before cooking
words.example: Marinate the pork with garlic and honey.
words.exampleVi: Ướp thịt lợn với tỏi và mật ong.

words.explanationEn: to scatter small drops or bits over something
words.example: Sprinkle some peanuts on the noodles.
words.exampleVi: Rắc ít lạc lên mì.

words.explanationEn: having a strong hot taste, like chili
words.example: Is this soup too spicy for you?
words.exampleVi: Canh này có cay quá với bạn không?

words.explanationEn: having a sharp taste like a lemon
words.example: Sour fish soup is a southern dish.
words.exampleVi: Canh chua cá là món miền Nam.

words.explanationEn: tasting like sea water
words.example: The soup is a bit salty.
words.exampleVi: Canh hơi mặn.

words.explanationEn: hard and pleasant to bite, making a sound when you eat it
words.example: I love crispy fried chicken.
words.exampleVi: Tôi thích gà rán giòn.

words.explanationEn: ready to be eaten, used about fruit
words.example: These bananas are not ripe yet.
words.exampleVi: Những quả chuối này chưa chín.
